description: This PHP source file defines the 'RegistrationEventQueue' entity class, which models a queue for registration event-related data in the OrangeHRM system. It includes constants representing event types and properties mapping to database columns, such as event details, timestamps, and data payload, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueue
classes.description: Entity class representing a queue of registration events, with properties such as event type, timestamps, and payload data, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_registration_event_queue'. It provides constants for event types and getter/setter methods for all properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the registration event queue record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the registration event queue record.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of event associated with the queue entry.

methods.name: setEventType
methods.description: Sets the type of event for the queue entry.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the event has been published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the event.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the event occurred.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the event occurred.

methods.name: getPublishTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: setPublishTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data payload associated with the event.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data payload for the event.
